files.geometry: results/volumetric/decomposition/l_box/geometry.npz (mesh_vertices, mesh_faces, vertices, tetrahedra, piece_of, piece surfaces v<j>/f<j>)
files.paths: results/volumetric/decomposition/l_box/paths.npz (p<j>: path of piece j; e<j>: indices of its exterior segments)

geometry.coordinates: normalised: x_norm = (x_model - centre) * scale + 0.5, which fits the model bounding box in [0.05, 0.95]^3; lengths are model units times scale

tetgen.memory_definition: Peak sampled sum of process-tree RSS during this stage (20 ms sampling)

partition.method: explicit two boxes (exact convex control): each tetrahedron owned by the box containing its centre

coverage_volume.method: sum of tetrahedron volumes vs polygonal-solid volume

coverage_samples.method: evaluation samples inside the polygonal solid (winding > 1/2) that lie in no piece

ownership.method: tetrahedron-to-piece ownership array: every tetrahedron has exactly one owner

overlap_samples.method: evaluation samples that lie in two or more pieces

volume_conservation.method: sum of piece volumes vs object tetrahedral volume; each piece surface volume vs its tetrahedral volume

piece_surfaces.method: every piece surface closed and consistently oriented (needed for winding numbers)

transport.acceptance: mapchain.volumetric.transport.acceptance_report: per-cell relative mass error < 1e-6, no empty or non-positive cells, finite centroids, centroid i power-nearest to Hilbert site i
transport.paths: independent: one Hilbert-ordered centroid polyline per piece; never connected

measurement_protocol.domain: the assigned piece Omega_j used by its solve
measurement_protocol.membership: generalised winding number of the closed piece surface (libigl); inside when >= 1/2
measurement_protocol.distance: exact point-to-triangle distance to the piece surface (libigl AABB)
measurement_protocol.boundary_tolerance: a sample counts as outside only if winding < 1/2 and distance > 1e-09
measurement_protocol.sampling: uniform samples along each segment, ceil(length/0.001)+1 per segment, endpoints included; spacing <= 0.001
measurement_protocol.note: sampled measurements: zero exterior segments is not a containment certificate and the sampled depth is not a bound

certificate_protocol.quantity: delta_j = sup over conv(Omega_j) of dist(z, Omega_j), normalised units
certificate_protocol.bound:
on cubes of half-size s (r = s sqrt 3) covering conv(Omega_j): a cube meets the
hull only if its centre is within r of every facet plane; dist(., Omega_j) is 1-Lipschitz, so a
cube's supremum is at most max(0, sd(c) + r) + EPS, with sd(c) = -d(c) only if c is robustly inside
(winding within 1/4 of 1 and d > TAU) and +d(c) otherwise. The lower bound L is the largest d at a
robustly outside centre inside the hull. Cubes with bound <= L are pruned; the rest are split until
U - L <= tol. Assumption: the generalised winding number is correct to within 1/4 at points
farther than TAU from the surface.

density.target: uniform: rho = 1/|Omega| on the represented solid
density.conditional: rho_j = rho / w_j = 1/|Omega_j| on piece A
density.solver_input: unit nodal density on the piece tetrahedra, normalised by the solver to total mass 1

certificate.method: piece volume equals its convex-hull volume within relative 1e-09; a closed piece inside its hull with equal volume is the hull, so delta_j = 0

acceptance.hilbert_order_check: centroid i power-nearest to Hilbert site i (convex Laguerre cell)

density.target: uniform: rho = 1/|Omega| on the represented solid
density.conditional: rho_j = rho / w_j = 1/|Omega_j| on piece B
density.solver_input: unit nodal density on the piece tetrahedra, normalised by the solver to total mass 1

certificate.method: piece volume equals its convex-hull volume within relative 1e-09; a closed piece inside its hull with equal volume is the hull, so delta_j = 0

acceptance.hilbert_order_check: centroid i power-nearest to Hilbert site i (convex Laguerre cell)

timing.boundaries: coacd: CoACD hull computation (cached runs report the original time); tetrahedralization: TetGen; partition: ownership, components, piece surfaces; checks: partition checks; solve_wall: all piece solves in parallel (each solve_seconds: nested solve + acceptance in its worker); certificate and measurement per piece; total: whole script
timing.concurrency: 2 worker processes, one piece per task
